currency.basis: The press page using this asset has content dated through 2026; the chevron mark is UniCredit's post-2023 rebrand, and the accepted sphere/swoosh icon is the superseded pre-2023 design.

identity.basis: The fetched SVG is served from unicredit.pl (official UniCredit domain) as the live press-site logo and depicts the UniCredit chevron mark; no third-party copy is involved.

assessment.independenceRationale: The primary observation is the official UniCredit press site serving the asset; Wikimedia and group brand page checks independently rule out better vector sources and corroborate the rebrand timeline.

variant.basis: Standalone symbol variant (two right-pointing chevrons, #E2001A, transparent background, 48x48 canvas) with no accompanying wordmark, matching catalog standalone-mark suitability.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Both chevron outlines, their rounded ends and the even gap between them are preserved; no stroke or contour loss against the working version or the original source.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Symbol fills the square cell usefully with the canvas's own small margins; renders cleanly at 24/32/48 px on white and #121212; chevrons remain distinct and recognizable at small sizes on both themes.
candidate.rationale: Replace the superseded pre-2023 UniCredit sphere/swoosh icon with the current two-chevron mark (#E2001A), taken from an original self-contained SVG served by UniCredit's own press-site DAM. This is an evidenced brand update, not a serialization change.
candidate.role: Standalone bank symbol: the two-chevron mark is the entire current UniCredit symbol, with no accompanying wordmark or explanatory text.
transforms: No geometric transformation: the original vector paths were used unchanged (no scaling, translation or path edits needed; the 48x48 viewBox already fits the square catalog cell).

candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Before/after shows a real design change: the old red sphere with white swoosh is replaced by the current double-chevron mark. This is UniCredit's post-2023 rebrand, not a cosmetic or byte-level change.

proposals.reason: The accepted icon is the pre-2023 UniCredit sphere/swoosh mark; UniCredit's current brand (in use since the 2023 rebrand) is the two-chevron red mark, observed as the live logo asset of the official UniCredit press site (unicredit.pl DAM, page content current to 2026). The fetched asset is a self-contained original vector SVG (525 bytes, two filled paths, #E2001A) with no external references; raster tracing was not involved.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original self-contained SVG (525 bytes, two #E2001A chevron paths) of the current UniCredit mark, served by UniCredit's own press-site DAM; replaces the superseded pre-2023 sphere/swoosh accepted icon.

sources.observation: Official UniCredit Poland press page renders its logo from this DAM asset in three places; the asset is the current two-chevron UniCredit mark in #E2001A.
All 8 Wikimedia SVGs in the UniCredit category are subsidiary or legacy (1998/2017) marks; none depicts the current chevron, so no better independent vector source exists there.

Official group brand page (search-result observation; direct fetch HTTP 403) confirming the current group brand identity; unicredit.it and unicreditgroup.eu direct fetches returned 403, so the accessible unicredit.pl DAM asset was used.
